messages:
maria_support: Hey team — customer #30210 reporting intermittent Google OAuth failures. After the consent screen they get redirected back but our callback returns 400 'state mismatch'. Happens only through their corporate proxy/CDN.

kevin_eng: Do we know how big the state param is for that flow? Our SDK currently encodes PKCE + a bunch of app metadata in the state (base64 JSON).

maria_support: They pasted the callback URL; state looks truncated: expected a ~800-char base64 blob, but callback query has ~260 chars and ends in '...'. They see the error immediately after redirect.

marco_sre: this rings a bell — proxies/CDNs sometimes chunk or truncate Set-Cookie or header values when they exceed limits, or they coalesce multiple Set-Cookie headers in a way clients don't reassemble. If we store the PKCE/state across multiple cookie chunks (e.g., rdw_state_1, rdw_state_2...) the client or proxy may only forward the last chunk.

kevin_eng: can you paste the request/response headers from the customer (sanitized)?

maria_support: sure — from the callback request they forwarded:
```
GET /auth/callback?code=4/...&state=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR...truncated
Host: app.example-corp.com
Cookie: rdw_state_3=yz...; session=abcd
```
And earlier when we set cookies on /login response we see in our logs:
```
Set-Cookie: rdw_state_1=eyJhbGciOiJ...; Path=/; HttpOnly
Set-Cookie: rdw_state_2=0a9f...; Path=/; HttpOnly
Set-Cookie: rdw_state_3=yz...; Path=/; HttpOnly
```
But the customer-proxy request only includes `rdw_state_3` in Cookie header.

marco_sre: yep — the proxy is dropping/merging headers. Common causes: header size limits, chunked Set-Cookie handling in the CDN, or a misconfigured ingress that rewrites/folds cookies. Also some clients/browsers will only keep a limited number of cookies per domain.

kevin_eng: reproduction notes: I repro'd locally by configuring Traefik with small header buffer sizes and the same cookie-chunking in our auth flow; callback ended up missing first chunks -> PKCE state reconstruction failed -> state mismatch.

kevin_eng: Suggested fixes:
- Short term: change SDK/server to store full state server-side (DB/redis) and put a short 16-32 char key in the state query param. This avoids large cookies/headers entirely.
- Medium: update SDK to auto-fallback to server-side state whenever encoded state > 200 chars.
- Ops fix: advise customer to increase allowed header size / disable cookie chunking on CDN, or configure it to forward all Set-Cookie headers. For nginx: large_client_header_buffers and proxy_buffer_size tweaks; for other proxies, consult provider docs.

maria_support: Customer applied the short-term workaround (server-side key) and confirmed login succeeds via their CDN. They've requested a formal SDK patch so they don't have to modify their flow.

marco_sre: I'll add a runbook entry for this class of problems (cookie chunking / header truncation) with detection rules: if state length on initial response > 300 and callback state length < 300 -> flag possible truncation.

kevin_eng: I'll open a PR to implement the auto server-side-state fallback in the SDK and add tests that simulate header truncation.

opsbot: deploy scheduled: auth-sdk/patch/short-state-fallback -> staging at 2026-03-17T22:00Z :rocket: 

maria_support: great, marking this thread as resolved for now (customer verified workaround). We'll keep it open until the SDK patch lands. :thumbsup:
